message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout just as dinner was winding down. My kids were initially a bit freaked out, but I grabbed our trusty power bank and some flashlights, and suddenly it turned into an adventure! We set up a little glow-in-the-dark dinner party with flashlights as our 'candles.' It reminded me how much kids love a little creativity, even in the dark. Now, I always keep those power banks charged and ready — just in case! What’s your go-to tip for making power outages more fun?
